Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The decision meets the second completion option of #1896. It records the chosen behavior, the containment argument, the alternatives, and the cost of a later change.

The code supports the stated flank-angle limit, pass offsets, half-turn contracts, and stock-simulation refusal. The existing endpoint assertions remain unchanged.

Local results against upstream/main af83da0f405cfd244f0c9bf8192ab7309e9db824:
- The trial merge succeeds. The upstream main commit is already an ancestor of this head.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test lathe_post_g76_sources`: 3 passed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --test turning_thread_infeed -- plans_that_cannot_cut_refuse_by_name flank_infeed_shifts_each_pass_along_its_flank`: 2 passed.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --dry-run`: passed; selected the endpoint test.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 1 step passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed with no warnings.

Requested changes: none.

Mutations: not applicable. This PR changes documentation and one test comment. It changes no executable code, assertions, posted G-code, safety checks, simulation, or geometry. No goldens moved. No UI screenshots are required.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
